Fixes #19878

## Change

`Neo.list.ValuePicker.createPooledItem()` built the option `aria-label` as `<label>, <count> matches` for every count, so a value with one match was announced as "1 matches". It now uses `match` when the count is exactly 1 and `matches` otherwise ("0 matches", "1 match", "2 matches").

The e2e expectations in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderMenuStateNL.spec.mjs` that asserted `, 1 matches` now assert `, 1 match`.

## Design choice

None. The singular form for a count of one is the only reading of the issue's acceptance criteria.

## Tests

- Unit: added `option aria-label uses singular "match" for a count of one and plural otherwise` to `test/playwright/unit/list/ValuePicker.spec.mjs`.
  - Before the fix: failed with `"Value 0, 1 matches"` vs expected `"Value 0, 1 match"`.
  - After the fix: `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/list/ValuePicker.spec.mjs` passes, 13 of 13.
- E2E (`HeaderMenuStateNL.spec.mjs`): not run locally. The browser tier runs in CI; only the expected strings changed.

## Not verified

- The e2e browser tier was not run locally.
